sources.excerpt: Official Tysons page identifies Chima Steakhouse at 8010 Towers Crescent Dr/Plaza, Tysons, Virginia 22182, phone 703-639-3080, and links the current menu and allergen surfaces.

The ALLERGIES page is stamped UPDATE ON 2026-07-30 02:57:47 pm, provides category-by-item allergen markers, and states all dishes are prepared in a shared kitchen and no item can be guaranteed completely free of allergens.
Current Complete Rodizio menu enumerates meats, seafood, chicken, sausage, grilled cheese, vegetables, pineapple, and side dishes; it warns some items are seasonal or not available at every location.
Current Select Rodizio menu lists top sirloin, chicken, seafood, sides, gourmet salad bar, and grilled pineapple.
Current Gourmet Salad Bar page lists over 35 salads, charcuterie, cheeses, seafood, hot dishes, bread, and accompaniments and notes seasonal/location variability.
Current Bar Appetizers page enumerates appetizers, grill items, configurable churrasco boards, bar plates, sides, and sauces.
Current dessert page lists eight desserts. It describes Tropical Coconut Delight as nuts and gluten free, while the contemporaneous allergen grid positively marks Gluten for that item.
Tysons-only happy-hour page lists nine food offerings Monday-Friday 4:30-7 PM; alcohol-only sections are out of scope.
Tysons Taste of Chima menu is active nightly July 13-August 2, 2026 and lists twelve included cuts and grilled items.
Tysons weekday-lunch page corroborates salad-bar items, select cuts, and the current Chima Wagyu Signature Burger.
Tysons Salad Bar Experience page enumerates salads, charcuterie, cheeses, hot items, preserves, and accompaniments available at the location.
Restaurant-linked Toast storefront identifies 8010 Towers Crescent Drive, Vienna VA 22182 and exposes current entrees, appetizers, salads/sides, nonalcoholic beverages, and desserts.
Official-domain sitemap/document inspection found the live HTML allergen guide but no separate current nutrition PDF, ingredient PDF, or downloadable allergen document.

Targeted site and web searches for Chima allergen, allergy, nutrition, ingredients, PDF, and menu corroborated the official guide and Tysons Toast storefront; no higher-authority separate matrix was found.

findings.summary: Tysons identity is exact and unambiguous. Chain menu pages linked by Tysons are separated from Tysons-only ordering, happy-hour, lunch, salad-bar, and limited-time surfaces; other Chima locations are excluded.

The restaurant-issued allergen grid is live and stamped July 30, 2026. Direct positives are retained item by item; unmarked rows are not converted into unsupported absence certainty and remain unavailable.

NARROW SOL PACKET: the current dessert page explicitly describes Tropical Coconut Delight as nuts and gluten free, while the current allergen grid positively marks Gluten for the same item. Preserve gluten as a direct positive pending binding Sol resolution; do not publish the negative claim. The guide shows no Nuts marker, and the frozen tree-nut value is not retained as a direct positive.
The official shared-kitchen/no-guarantee statement applies at restaurant level only and is not smeared into every product mayContain array.

The 56-row frozen catalog covers only a subset of the current menu/allergen boundary and includes six non-product page artifacts or headings; current chain and Tysons-specific surfaces add substantial products and presentations.

proposedChanges: Replace the 56-row partial/artifact-bearing boundary with the consolidated current product union from the live allergen guide, official menu pages, Tysons food-only happy hour and limited-time menu, and the exact-location Toast food/nonalcoholic storefront.
Remove six page-title, author, form-message, and experience-heading artifacts while preserving every frozen audit key exactly once in reconciliation.

Preserve only direct item allergen positives from the official grid or explicit restaurant/vendor ingredient descriptions; keep products with no direct positive as unavailable rather than claiming absence.
Store the shared-kitchen/no-guarantee language at restaurant level without populating item mayContain fields.
Send only the Tropical Coconut Delight gluten-positive versus gluten-free current-source conflict to Sol for binding resolution.
